note: License facts read from each upstream LICENSE file at the pinned commit. Vendor terms of service and counsel review are NOT verified. Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/ecosystem.py render

projects.role: Terminal and desktop coding agent: the FreeIDE coding surface.
projects.gate: Provider base URL -> OpenVault /v1. Shell, edit and fetch tools -> Cortex tool_runner and OpenVault POST /api/crew/gate.

projects.role: Editor extension and CLI that is itself an opencode fork. Take the extension only; core stays on freeide.
projects.gate: Same as freeide. Both copyright lines (Kilo Code, opencode) stay in LICENSE.

projects.role: Fleet board for parallel coding agents in isolated git worktrees. Closer analogue to Netie Control than Guacamole.
projects.gate: Board reads ids only through netie.control.project_board. Agent launches go through Crew ticket runner, never a second orchestrator.

projects.role: Long-running personal agent with skills, sessions and messaging gateways.
projects.gate: Model calls -> OpenVault /v1. Tools -> Cortex tool_runner. Session state persists ids only (crew_checkpoint).

projects.role: Single Rust binary agent runtime for edge devices and small servers with 30+ channels.
projects.gate: Same as crew-agent. NOTICE and both license files stay (Apache-2.0 requires NOTICE retention).

projects.role: Everything-is-a-plugin agent harness with web UI, headless command and Python SDK. Developer preview, version 0.1.0-rc.5 per its README.
projects.gate: Model plugin -> OpenVault /v1. Tool and sandbox plugins register only through Cortex tool_runner.

projects.role: Agent harness library. A library is depended on, not forked: a fork buys a permanent rebase tax and no buyer-visible gain.
projects.gate: Already wrapped: scripts/crew_deepagents.py (bind_deep_agent, crew_harness_profile, TokenBudget). Contract tested here; no product repo ships it yet.

projects.license: MIT core, ee/ under OpenWork EE License
projects.role: Desktop session UX plus capability MCP. Overlaps AirGPT and Pointer, so ship only if a buyer asks for the desk.
projects.gate: Capability MCP -> netie.crew search_capabilities / execute_capability (granted ids only).
projects.why: Everything under ee/ is under the OpenWork Enterprise Edition License, not MIT. Delete it before any distribution.

projects.role: Memory layer for personal identity and preferences. Depend on the package, wrap it, brand the wrapper.
projects.gate: Every memory write is a Cortex action with an actor and a ledger entry. Reads stay inside the Space manifest. See scripts/ov_memory.py.

projects.role: CLI that writes and maintains a linked markdown wiki (code brain and personal brain) with claims tied to versioned evidence.
projects.gate: Grounded claims map to Netie-KB ids. Source connectors (mail, notes) run only through OpenVault leave-machine.

projects.role: Pipeline and context-engineering library. Closest open analogue to Cortex plumbing; does not provide the gate.
projects.gate: Components run under Cortex tool_runner. Retrieval over a Space cites only granted tables.

projects.role: Multi-provider chat shell. MIT, so it is the rebrandable base for AirGPT.
projects.gate: Endpoints -> OpenVault /v1 only (0002-gate.patch, tested). Retrieval -> netie.airgpt retrieve_space (not wired). Cross-chat memory off and labeled ungoverned until it routes through Cortex actions.

projects.role: AI gateway: one endpoint, fallback chains, circuit breaker, quota awareness. The FreeRoute base.
projects.gate: Keys live only in OpenVault. Every leave-machine call passes POST /api/crew/gate with skill ids.
disable: providers that reuse an end user's Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor or Antigravity subscription login
any adapter that drives another vendor's UI to dodge its meter
projects.why: TAS/ESTATE-GAP refuses billing-bypass products and NETIE.md defines the Vault as consented custody. Vendor terms of service for the subscription-login providers are not counsel-reviewed.

projects.role: Ancestor of OmniRoute (OmniRoute issue 5538 calls itself its superset). Mine for ideas, do not ship both.
projects.gate: Same as freeroute.
disable: subscription-login providers (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity)
projects.why: Same billing-bypass refusal as freeroute. Superseded by freeroute; keep only if a feature is missing there.

projects.role: Go proxy: credential pooling, round-robin, per-key rate limits, fail2ban. The high-throughput data plane under FreeRoute.
projects.gate: Credentials are issued by OpenVault. The router holds no key of its own.

projects.role: Self-hosted deploy platform: git push to deploy, TLS, rollbacks. The FreeBuild base.
projects.gate: A live label goes through claim_deploy (netie.route report_deploy). Simulated is never reported as live.
disable: cdn.oblien.com and Gellix font references (OpenVault DR-0003 explicitly did not copy them)
projects.why: Fonts and CDN assets are separate from the Apache-2.0 code grant. Use system fonts.

projects.license: Dify Open Source License (Apache-2.0 plus extra conditions)
projects.role: Visual agent workflow platform. Run it unmodified per customer; do not fork or resell.
projects.gate: Reached only through a Cortex connector. One customer per deployment.
projects.alt: Constructor stays ours: it compiles a canvas graph on Cortex.
projects.why: No multi-tenant operation without written authorization (one tenant is one workspace), and the LOGO and copyright in the web/ frontend may not be removed or modified.

projects.license: Sustainable Use License 1.0 (plus .ee. files under n8n Enterprise License)
projects.role: Workflow automation. Closest analogue to Constructor and to the Cortex DAG surface.
projects.gate: Not applicable.
projects.alt: Ship Constructor. Offer an n8n connector for customers who hold their own n8n license.
projects.why: Use or modify only for your own internal business purposes or non-commercial use; distribute only free of charge for non-commercial purposes. Cannot be rebranded, resold or hosted for customers.

projects.license: Open WebUI License (BSD-3-Clause style plus branding clause)
projects.role: Chat shell. Looks like a rebrand candidate and is not.
projects.gate: Not applicable.
projects.why: Altering, removing or replacing the Open WebUI branding is a material breach unless the deployment has 50 or fewer end users in 30 days, or written permission or an enterprise license is held.

projects.role: Prompt-complexity router: cheap or local model for simple prompts, premium for hard ones.
projects.gate: Not applicable.
projects.alt: Reimplement tiered routing inside FreeRoute from the idea only, in original code, without reading or copying NadirClaw source. Or buy its commercial license.
projects.why: Commercial use, including building or operating a paid product or service, needs a separate commercial license.

projects.role: Gateway with multi-policy scoring and an LLM-native routing policy.
projects.gate: Run unmodified as a separate service behind OpenVault. Never link it into closed code.
projects.alt: Buy the commercial license (contact is in its NOTICE.md) before forking, or take scoring ideas only.
projects.why: AGPL-3.0: a modified version served over a network must offer its source. Its NOTICE.md sells a commercial license for closed-source or SaaS use.
